history.sg_progress: The United Nations Office at Geneva has already initiated work in preparation for its 2026 budget submission. As part of this process, the Office is actively assessing the impact of proposed post abolitions and continues to refine its approach to resource prioritization. This includes defining the minimum level of administrative services required to implement the Office’s mandate effectively, and determining the corresponding staffing and resources needed to sustain essential functions.
